E004 asks for versions/dates and explicitly withholds a supersession determination pending verification. It supplies procedure and decision status, not a substantive answer to the precedence question. The model correctly includes an INSTRUCTION but also adds unlinked DIRECT ANSWER I007; the exporter consequently lists it as a provisional answer and counts a member with an ANSWER item. That classification remains unsupported under the clarified question-scope instructions. The exact quote, both OPEN questions and existing unlinked-answer review mitigate the risk; no policy precedence is invented and the canonical text must not be rewritten. The count is mechanically correct for the returned inventory, not proof that its classification is semantically correct.

findings.explanation: M05/E014 asks whether to Quarantine. E015 establishes inability to evaluate during the playback failure and gives reporting/do-not-score-as-model-quality guidance, but never decides Quarantine eligibility or whether reporting replaces Quarantine. Those actions are not established as mutually exclusive. The same-member ANSWER link is structurally valid and its useful guidance must be retained, but ANSWERED I016 overstates full settlement of the actual question and excludes M05 from open_questions. Depending on which substantive component is judged answered, OPEN or PARTIAL may be defensible; the finding does not require a predetermined replacement label or repair the response. M06 asks a broader Quarantine-versus-player-issue alternative, for which the playback-incident reply is a more defensible answer; no blanket relabeling of both conversations is proposed.
